_schema: type: consumable|weapon|armor|material|keepsake. `price` is the single source of value -- shops sell at buyRate*price and buy at sellRate*price. statMods apply while equipped in `slot`. A keepsake has no price, no slot and noSell, so every filter in shop.js and menu.js already passes over it.

emberbrew.name: Emberbrew
emberbrew.desc: Steeped embercaps. Tastes of hot stone and stops you bleeding.

field-poultice.name: Field Poultice
field-poultice.desc: Moss, linen and someone else's opinion about your wound.

embercap.name: Embercap
embercap.desc: Still faintly warm. They come up after rain along the walls and down the ravine.

reed-cord.name: Reed Cord
reed-cord.desc: Plaited from the bed by the ford. Holds anything that is not in a hurry.

iron-scale.name: Iron Scale
iron-scale.desc: Flaked off a bellow's hide. Hobb will take all you can carry.

town-blade.name: Town Blade
town-blade.desc: The sword you walked in with. Honest, and about as sharp.

smiths-edge.name: Smith's Edge
smiths-edge.desc: Hobb's own. The bevel is uneven and it does not matter.

river-steel.name: River Steel
river-steel.desc: Folded thin. Light enough that the third swing arrives when you meant it to.

travellers-coat.name: Traveller's Coat
travellers-coat.desc: Green wool, three seasons of road. Yours.

drovers-jack.name: Drover's Jack
drovers-jack.desc: Quilted for a winter spent walking behind sheep.

warden-mail.name: Warden's Mail
warden-mail.desc: Riveted rings over leather. You will hear yourself coming.

bell-token.name: Bell Token
bell-token.desc: Brass, worn smooth. Given to anyone who has rung the tower and admitted it.
